jobs.description:
RaySearch develops innovative software solutions to improve cancer care. Over 1200 clinics in more than 54 countries use RaySearch software to improve treatments and quality of life for patients. RaySearch was founded in 2000 and is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. The headquarters is located in Stockholm, with subsidiaries in the US, Europe, Asia and Australia & New Zealand. Today we are more than 485 employees with a common vision of improving cancer care with innovative software. Our great staff is crucial for our success and we offer a fantastic working environment in modern offices, flexibility and good opportunities for development. We believe in equal opportunities, value diversity and work actively to prevent discrimination.
Clinical experience as a medical physicist, dosimetrist, radiation therapist or treatment planner and ready for a new challenge? Or just graduated and looking for your first job to use your new skills? Join RaySearch in Stockholm and help us help clinics improve their treatments with innovative medical technology software!
Location: Stockholm, Sweden
We prefer a candidate who can work from our headquarters in Stockholm. For a strong candidate we are however willing to consider work from a home office in Denmark, Norway or Finland.
About the position
As an Application & Physics Specialist you will join a diverse and dedicated specialist group with clinical experience from different countries. The group is part of the global service organization responsible for the promotion, deployment and support of our products as well as the education of our customers.  
The emphasis of the position will be on working with potential and current customers in the Nordic region to introduce them to our treatment planning system RayStation through demonstrations and training. This is done on client sites, in our training center in Stockholm, by webinars and at conferences. 
Another core task is creating and maintaining training materials on various formats such as interactive e-learning courses, PPT presentations and videos for students.
For a candidate with medical physics competence, you will also play an important role in assisting our customers during the beam commissioning process, for example by creating beam models and advising them on measurement requirements.
Up to 25% travel is required, primarily within the Nordic region and Europe.
Your main tasks
Planning, performing and documenting product trainings for customers and distributors
Demonstrating RaySearch products at trade shows and onsite for prospective customers
Develop and maintain training materials
Answering tenders and explain product functionality
Collaborating with our development department through exploratory testing of new product versions 
Assisting and guiding customers during the beam commissioning process

Your introduction
When starting in this position, you will get a mentor and a solid introduction to our products and ways of working following a formal certification program. You will gradually take more responsibility and start working independently.
Your profile
We believe that our new Application & Physics Specialist has a great sense for service and customer support and a strong motivation to work in a highly dynamic environment. You are a social and positive person with excellent interpersonal and communication skills and enjoy presenting and teaching to bigger and smaller crowds. 
Further, you can quickly adapt to new contexts and appreciate various environments as well as a variety of different tasks.  You enjoy facing new challenges and solving complex problems, both independently and in collaboration with your team members. You are comfortable with working proactively, taking initiatives and have the ability to prioritize your work and adapt to sudden changes. 
Experience & skills
Proficiency in spoken and written English
Swedish/Danish/Norwegian/Finnish skills are meriting
BSc or MSc degree in medical physics/dosimetry/RTT or equivalent, medical physics is meriting
Clinical experience in radiotherapy, especially proton therapy or brachytherapy, is meriting
Ability to travel up to 25% 
Medical device industry experience is meriting

Our culture
Culture at RaySearch is the driving force behind our organization, where everything we do is driven by a shared passion for innovation and the fight against cancer. Our dedication is reflected in our ability to deliver exceptional results, pay close attention to detail, and consistently go the extra mile. Our employees stand out as experts in their field, driven by a relentless focus on solving problems - no matter how complex. At RaySearch, we take pride in leading the way in cancer treatment, leveraging cutting-edge technology to develop innovative solutions that make a real difference in patient care.
Our offer
At RaySearch, we offer a diverse and inclusive work environment, fostering openness, sincerity, and collaboration. Located in Hagastaden, Stockholm's Life Science Hub, our modern and creative workspace includes an in-house gym, yoga, and social activities like ping pong, table football, and regular after-work events. Our bistro serves a fantastic lunch buffet, and we offer morning- and afternoon-fika every day. Our rooftop terrace also provides a stunning 360-degree view of Stockholm, enhancing the work experience. All of this comes attached with a competitive compensation and benefits package.
Application
Please apply through the application form below. The selection and interviewing process will be ongoing. We do not accept applications by e-mail.

Just outside Malmö you find a leading paint company with a focus on innovation and sustainability. One of the Nordic region's largest sites where we develop, manufacture, market and sell paint for indoor and outdoor environments for consumers, customers and industry. The business mainly consists of two companies. Akzo Nobel Industrial Coatings, a leader in the sale and manufacture of paints and coatings for industrial surface treatment for wood products such as windows, doors, floors, and furniture. Some of the customers are IKEA, Montana, Inwido and Tarkett. The other company Akzo Nobel Decorative Coatings develops, manufactures, distributes, and sells paints, varnishes, putty and wood protection products to professional painters and consumers. The portfolio includes the well-known brands Nordsjö, Sadolin and Cuprinol. 
 
 
Are you driven by creating smarter, more sustainable industrial operations? Join us on a two-year fixed-term contract in a key role where you will lead energy improvement initiatives, influence site performance and turn ambitious sustainability goals into measurable business results.
 
 
What can AkzoNobel offer you?
At AkzoNobel you are met by a warm and welcoming atmosphere. We work together with a focus on innovation and sustainability, to be the leader in our industry. Diversity enriches our workplaces, and we work actively together with our employees to make them thrive and develop. We work strategically to become a better employer. This has resulted in that we have been appointed one of Sweden's Career Company 2026. We offer you an international working environment where you take on rewarding and challenging tasks that broaden your horizon and develop you in your role. You will work with competent and like-minded colleagues who share your attitude and enthusiasm. Welcome!
 
 
About the role 
As Projects Manager – Energy, you will play a central role in driving the energy agenda at our Malmö site forward. Working across production areas, buildings and utilities, you will identify opportunities, lead improvement initiatives and ensure that energy-saving projects are successfully implemented and followed up.
This is a broad and business-critical role where you combine technical expertise with project leadership and stakeholder management. You will collaborate closely with functions such as Engineering, Maintenance, Production, HSE and Procurement, while also acting as an important counterpart towards external contractors and facility management partners.

The position offers a great opportunity to make a visible impact by improving operational efficiency, reducing energy consumption and supporting long-term sustainability targets in a modern industrial environment.
 
Key responsibilities: 
• Lead and execute the Malmö Site Energy Roadmap
• Drive energy efficiency projects from concept to implementation• Identify and prioritize opportunities for energy and cost savings
• Monitor energy performance, KPIs and metering systems
• Develop business cases, project scopes and implementation plans
• Coordinate energy-related activities across the site
• Optimize HVAC, BMS, ventilation and utility performance
• Challenge and coordinate facility management and external contractors
• Support shutdown and non-production energy reduction initiatives
• Follow up, verify and report realized savings and project results
 
This is a full-time position on a two-year fixed-term contract, based in Arlöv, just outside Malmö. You will report to the Project Manager Lead.
 
 
Who are you?
We are looking for someone who enjoys combining analytical thinking with hands-on project execution. You are comfortable working in a dynamic industrial environment where collaboration, initiative and continuous improvement are key to success.
 

You have the ability to build strong relationships across different functions and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. At the same time, you are confident in challenging existing ways of working and driving improvements that create long-term value for the business.
 

To succeed in this role, you should have a structured approach, strong problem-solving skills and a genuine interest in energy efficiency and sustainable operations.
 
 
Key qualifications: 
• Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Energy or another relevant Engineering field
• Experience in industrial energy management and/or energy efficiency projects• Project management experience within industrial or manufacturing environments
• Knowledge of industrial utilities, energy systems and energy monitoring
• Experience working with HVAC/BMS and related optimization activities
• Ability to develop technical and financial business cases
• Strong stakeholder and contractor management skills
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills in both Swedish and English
 
Meritorious / preferred: 
• Experience with ISO 50001• Previous experience as an Energy Engineer or Industrial Energy Manager
• Experience with energy KPI and metering systems
• Background in CAPEX/OPEX project delivery
• Experience implementing energy-saving initiatives in industrial environments
 
 
Your application 
At AkzoNobel we are very committed to ensuring an inclusive and respectful workplace where all employees can be their best selves. We strive to embrace diversity, tolerance and respect. Our recruitment process plays a major role in this journey as it lays the foundation for a diverse work environment. In our organization, all qualified applicants are treated from an equal perspective regardless of ethnic origin, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age or disability.
 
We review applications on an ongoing basis and encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Please note that we do not accept applications via email.
 
For information about the role and recruitment process, please contact Ami Sandberg, Talent Acquisition Partner Nordics, ami.sandberg@akzonobel.com

TL;DR
We're looking for an exceptional AI Software Engineer to build the AI-powered People systems that help Lovable scale.
As Lovable grows, we're rethinking how work gets done. Rather than relying on traditional HR software, we're building AI-native products that transform hiring, onboarding, workforce planning, identity, compliance, and other core People workflows.
You'll work embedded with our People team, partnering closely with stakeholders to understand problems, design solutions, and ship production-ready software. Many of the products you build won't stop at improving Lovable internally — they have the potential to become capabilities we offer to customers in the future, giving you the opportunity to shape products that start inside Lovable and scale far beyond it.
Why Lovable?
Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
Why join now?
Very few engineering roles offer this level of ownership.
You'll help define how AI transforms internal operations. You'll work directly with the People team to identify problems, design solutions, and build products that improve how Lovable operates every day.
As Lovable scales, we're building the operating system the company runs on—function by function, directly in Lovable. The People team is one of the first. You'll help define how AI transforms one of our most important internal functions, and the best ideas will eventually become building blocks for our customers.
What we're looking for
We're looking for a software engineer with strong product instincts and experience building secure software that handles sensitive information.
You'll likely have:
Experience shipping production software that handles sensitive data — HR tech, fintech, identity management, or similar.
Experience working with people data, business systems, analytics platforms, or enterprise data infrastructure (e.g. BigQuery, Snowflake, Databricks, Airflow, Fivetran, SQL, etc.).
Deep familiarity with HR systems and/or ATS platforms (HiBob, Ashby, Workday, Greenhouse, or similar), either as a builder or through close collaboration with People teams.
Experience designing secure systems with role-based access control and data permissioning.
Strong product instincts—you think end-to-end, ask why, and care about building products people actually use.
Excellent stakeholder management skills and the ability to translate operational challenges into technical solutions.
Experience building products from scratch and taking them into production.

Bonus points if you have:
Experience at an HR technology company, Work OS platform, or identity provider,
Experience with HRIS, ATS, compensation, workforce planning tools.
Experience building AI-powered products or internal tooling.
Experience working closely with People or Operations teams.

What you'll do
In one sentence:
Build AI-powered People systems that make Lovable run better — and create products that can graduate from internal tools to customer-facing features.
Examples include:
Partner with the People team to identify, scope, and ship AI-powered internal products.
Build integrations with HR systems (HiBob, Ashby, etc.), ATS platforms, and identity providers.
Design secure systems with robust role-based permissions and access controls.
Develop predictive and diagnostic models (workforce trends, hiring capacity, retention risks, compensation dynamics).
Create canonical datasets and source-of-truth models for hiring, headcount, compensation, organizational design, and workforce planning.
Data governance — source-of-truth logic, naming conventions, ownership.
Own products end-to-end—from research and design through implementation, deployment, and iteration.
Translate operational challenges into elegant technical solutions.
Build systems that meet legal and compliance requirements for handling sensitive employee data.
Work closely with other AI Ops Engineers, sharing building blocks, patterns, and learnings across Lovable's functions.
Build AI agents, workflows, dashboards, and decision-support tools that help leaders make better decisions.

Our tech stack
We're building with tools that both humans and AI love.
Languages: TypeScript, Python, Go
AI: OpenAI, Anthropic, MCP, AI Agents
Business Systems: HiBob, Ashby, Okta
Infrastructure: Cloudflare, PostgreSQL, Temporal

Please submit your application in English — it's our company language.

jobs.description:
🚀 Challenge the Impossible​ ​
 
About Beyond Gravity
Beyond Gravity, headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, is the first space company to combine a startup mindset, agility, speed and innovation with decades of experience and proven quality. Approximately 1800 employees at 12 locations in six countries (Switzerland, Sweden, Austria, USA, Finland and Portugal) develop and manufacture products for satellites and launch vehicles with the goal of advancing humankind and enabling the exploration of the world and beyond. Beyond Gravity is the preferred supplier of structures for all types of launch vehicles and a leading provider of selected satellite products and constellation solutions in the New Space sector. In 2024, the company generated a revenue of around CHF 359 million. More information at: www.beyondgravity.com
 
Your crew

Join a highly collaborative, cross-functional team at the heart of Beyond Gravity’s Electronics business. Working closely with Engineering, Product Management, Programs, Production and other functions, you will contribute to the development of satellite onboard systems, platform and payload products as well as ground electronics products.
As an Electronics System Engineer, you will work at system and architectural level, providing system engineering expertise for electronics hardware systems, embedded processing systems and platform and payload solutions across development projects and series production programs in the satellite electronic solutions domain.
This is a role with significant development potential. You will have the opportunity to take increasing ownership, broaden your technical expertise and grow towards more advanced system engineering responsibilities over time.
 
Your mission

The Electronics System Engineer is responsible for:
Take ownership of your scope and bring assigned tasks to completion, involving more senior colleagues when needed.
Develop and maintain satellite onboard systems, platform and payload products as well as ground electronics products at system and architectural level.
Analyse and understand internal and external customer requirements and translate them into system-level requirements and technical solutions.
Break down system requirements into subsystem and module requirements and establish corresponding design requirements.
Develop technical concepts and system designs appropriate to customer and project needs, considering cost, time, quality, performance and technical feasibility.
Perform and/or assess system-level analyses, including performance, radiation, structural, EMC, reliability, FDIR and HW/FPGA/SW interaction analyses.
Coordinate development activities with other teams and disciplines to ensure complete and intended implementation of the system.
Plan and execute your own activities, monitor progress against schedule and budget, and raise awareness of risks and blocking points.
Support bidding and proposal activities through technical descriptions, concept work, cost and schedule estimates and risk and opportunity assessments.
Contribute to continuous improvement of products, technologies, processes and ways of working, challenging established solutions where appropriate.
Interact with customers, suppliers and external stakeholders within your area of responsibility and provide technical know-how to support successful project execution.
Maintain and develop system-level documentation and ensure compliance with established development processes and standards.

 
Most important outputs:
Robust and efficient system solutions that meet customer and project requirements.
Successful delivery of system engineering activities within agreed scope, quality, schedule and budget.
Continuous development of products, technologies and engineering methods.

 
Your story

We are looking for a technically curious and solution-oriented System Engineer with a strong interest in satellite electronics and system engineering. You take ownership of your work, are comfortable working independently and enjoy finding solutions to complex technical challenges.
You have a collaborative mindset and enjoy working across disciplines, with the ability to communicate clearly with colleagues, customers and external partners. You are motivated by continuous learning and want to develop your expertise and responsibility over time.
This role is a great opportunity for someone with strong potential to grow towards more advanced system engineering responsibilities and, in time, a Senior System Engineer role.
 
Must-haves:
M.Sc. in Electrical, Software or Aerospace Engineering, or corresponding experience.
Experience or good knowledge in system engineering, electronics or embedded systems, preferably within the space industry.
Understanding of requirements engineering, functional decomposition and system design.
Ability to perform or assess system-level analyses and understand HW/FPGA/SW interactions.
Ability to work independently, take ownership and deliver within agreed scope, schedule and budget.
Strong collaboration and communication skills.
Structured and solution-oriented approach to technical challenges and risk.
Fluent English, written and spoken.

 
Nice to have’s:
Experience with satellite onboard systems, platform and payload products or ground electronics.
Knowledge of FPGA, hardware, RF, signal processing or embedded systems.
Experience with tools such as MATLAB, DOORS, PSA, FMECA, DOSRAD or Reliability.
Knowledge of ECSS, agile methods or model-based systems engineering.
Experience with technical coordination, customer interaction or proposal work.
Knowledge of product roadmaps and current technology trends.

 
Why Beyond Gravity
 
To work in a growing high technology company with career opportunities within the site or internationally.
You will be a part of an engaged team with the ambition to innovate space!
We offer a hybrid work situation, high flexibility and autonomy, and a great team to develop and have fun with!

 
🌌Are you ready for lift-off?​
Our core values - Passionate, Together, and Curious - transform challenges into opportunities. Embark on a journey to transcend the ordinary with us. We‘re actively reviewing candidates and will promptly select the ideal fit for our team.​
​Beyond Gravity is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
UMS SKELDAR is developing an unmanned helicopter to support naval, military and public safety operations. We have a fast and dynamic work environment with an entrepreneurial spirit. At UMS Skeldar, you get the unique chance to leave your footprint within our organization with fast reaction times and high engagement.

 Key words: Flight Manager, UAS Flight Manager, Unmanned Aircraft System, UAS Operations Manager, UAS Flight Operations Manager, Flight Operations Manager.
Join our Flight Operations team as a UAS Flight Manager and take a key role in leading and developing our growing flight organization. You will lead our flight operations, develop our flight crews and ways of working, and play an important part in shaping the future of unmanned aviation. We are looking for an experienced aviation or UAS professional who is ready to take the next step in their career and make a real impact in a dynamic and growing organization.UAS Flight Manager with us: 
As UAS Flight Manager, you will have overall responsibility for the safety and efficiency of our UAS flight operations. You will work closely with Remote Pilots, Flight Technicians, Engineering, Maintenance, Project Management, customers, and aviation authorities to ensure that our operations are planned and executed to the highest standards.
The role is both operational and strategic. You will be close to the daily flight operations while also developing our people, processes, and ways of working as our UAS operations continue to grow. You will report to the Head of Flight Operations.
As UAS Flight Manager, you will:

Lead and coordinate daily UAS flight operations, including planning, scheduling, execution, and post-flight activities, ensuring operations are conducted safely and in accordance with applicable regulations, authorizations, and company procedures.

Lead and develop our flight crews, including Remote Pilots, Flight Technicians, and Flight Test Engineers, with responsibility for training, proficiency, and competence management.

Drive safety and operational risk management, including safety reviews, risk assessments, audits, and continuous development of our Safety Management System (SMS).

Ensure operational readiness and compliance by working closely with Maintenance and reviewing flight-related procedures, documentation, records, and operational approvals.

Act as a key point of contact for operation sites, aviation authorities, customers, and internal stakeholders, supporting customer deliveries, demonstrations, new operational concepts, and other flight activities.

Drive continuous improvement across Flight Operations, identifying opportunities to improve safety, efficiency, processes, and operational performance.

Safety is at the heart of everything we do. As UAS Flight Manager, you will have the authority to suspend or cancel operations when safety or regulatory compliance is in question and to require additional training or proficiency measures when needed.
The workplace is dynamic, and the role may include both domestic and international travel depending on operational and organizational needs.
Does the position sound interesting? Do not hesitate to apply today!
Are you the one we are looking for? 
We place great emphasis on personal qualities so that you can thrive in the role. Therefore, we are looking for someone who is structured, safety-minded, and solution-oriented. You are confident in making well-considered decisions in a dynamic environment and know how to balance operational requirements with safety and regulatory compliance. You take ownership, communicate clearly, and build strong relationships with both operational teams and stakeholders across the organization. You are motivated by continuous improvement and have the drive to develop both yourself and the organization.
We believe you have at least five years of experience in flight operations management, aviation operations, or a comparable operational leadership role, with experience in UAS operations and/or commercial or military aviation. You have relevant education or professional training within aviation, aerospace, UAS, or military aviation, as well as a relevant UAS pilot license, certificate, or equivalent qualification. You have strong knowledge of aviation regulations and UAS operating requirements, combined with experience in operational risk management, safety processes, and a formal Safety Management System (SMS). You are experienced in leading, mentoring, and developing operational personnel and have a good understanding of flight planning, operational procedures, and aviation documentation. Excellent communication skills in English, both spoken and written, are essential.
Experience from multiple UAS platforms, complex operational authorizations, international operations, or military aviation is considered an advantage.
A B driver´s license is required.

an opportunity to be part of a dynamic company that is constantly evolving, where your impact plays an important role

a high-tech product that is currently at the forefront of the market

a familiar work culture characterised by collaboration and high engagement

activities that promote both social community and health, through our Party Committee, Health Committee, Board Game Committee and a Women's Network.

Bring the Future of Wind Propulsion Onboard

About Us
Wind helped us discover our planet, and now it can help us preserve it. Our vision is to provide wings for a shipping revolution, and we have two strong mother companies to back us up: Alfa Laval and Wallenius.
Would you like to contribute to this change, then join our fast-growing, highly competent and passionate team. AlfaWall Oceanbird AB is a 50/50 joint venture, owned by Alfa Laval and Wallenius but operated as an independent company. We are developing wing sail technology for the global shipping market and are now looking for an Installation Lead to join our team. Help us bring wind propulsion from shore to ship!
The role
As Oceanbird moves from a prototype stage into commercial customer delivery, successful installation is becoming one of our most important capabilities.
As Installation Lead, you will turn plans and technical solutions into safe, efficient and wellcoordinated installations at shipyards and onboard vessels. You will also be responsible for our demonstrator wing in Landskrona, coordinating its operation, maintenance and test readiness so that it provides the data needed for our continued development.

You will be part of the Project Management Office and work closely with our project managers. During installations, you will lead a cross-functional team of approximately 3–8 people, including electricians, service engineers, technical specialists and external contractors.
The Project Manager retains overall responsibility for the customer project, while you lead the dayto-day installation activities and safe execution at the shipyard, in harbor or at sea.

Your main responsibilities:
• Plan, prepare and lead installation and commissioning activities at shipyards/harbour and onboard vessels.
• Translate project and engineering requirements into practical installation plans, work sequences, resource needs and schedules.
• Coordinate the on-site installation team and act as Oceanbird’s operational interface with shipyards, vessel crews, customers and subcontractors.
• Lead the safe execution of installation work, ensuring that risk assessments, work permits, toolbox talks and agreed safety procedures are in place and followed.
• Monitor progress, quality and safety, resolve practical issues and escalate risks or decisions when required.
• Develop and maintain installation procedures, method statements, SOPs, checklists and installation manuals.
• Capture lessons learned and use them to improve future installations, documentation and ways of working.
• Coordinate the operation, maintenance, inspection and test readiness of the demonstrator wing and its supporting equipment in Landskrona.
• Plan activities together with the Landskrona team and work closely with our teams in Flemingsberg to incorporate experience from installations and testing into our continued development.

Who are you?
You are a practical and confident installation leader who can bring people from different disciplines together, create structure and maintain focus on safety and delivery—even when conditions change.
You are likely to have:
• Experience leading installations, commissioning, service or major maintenance involving complex mechanical or electromechanical equipment.

Classified by Alfa Laval as: Business
• Experience from commercial vessels and shipyards, ideally involving bulk carriers, tankers or similar vessel types.
• Experience from newbuild projects and working closely with shipyards in Asia is highly valuable.
• A relevant engineering qualification within mechanical, marine, electrical or a related technical field. This could be a vocational, college or bachelor-level qualification, or equivalent experience.
• A strong understanding of safe working practices in shipyard, industrial or onboard environments.
• Experience coordinating multidisciplinary teams, contractors and external stakeholders.
• The ability to produce clear and practical technical documentation, including SOPs and installation manuals.
• Professional proficiency in English and the willingness to travel internationally and work onboard vessels.

You are safety-conscious, structured and calm under pressure. You communicate clearly across technical disciplines and cultures and are comfortable moving between planning, documentation and hands-on execution.

Location and travel
We are open to discussing the location for the right candidate, although proximity to either Flemingsberg or Landskrona is preferred.
Regular international travel and periods of work at shipyards and onboard vessels are an integral part of the role.

What we offer
At Oceanbird, you will help turn a bold vision into working technology at sea. You will see the direct result of your work as our wing sail technology moves from development and testing to installation onboard commercial vessels—and ultimately into operation at sea.
This is an opportunity to shape not only how our first commercial installations are delivered, but how Oceanbird will install wing sails around the world in the future. Working alongside highly skilled and passionate colleagues, you will influence our installation methods, safety standards and ways of working—and contribute directly to making wind a powerful part of cleaner shipping.

Join us in redefining the future of clean shipping.
Apply today and be part of a journey that truly makes a difference!

You will take an active role in the daily operations and continuous development of LAYERED's online business, with a focus on driving sales, improving conversion and creating a seamless digital customer experience.
In this role, you will take ownership of the day-to-day e-commerce activities, working across website optimization, merchandising, CRM and customer retention. You will ensure that products, content and campaigns are presented in a commercially effective way, while continuously identifying opportunities to improve the customer journey and online performance.
You will work closely with colleagues across marketing and technology, combining hands-on execution with data-driven improvements. As part of a smaller, entrepreneurial organisation, you will have the opportunity to take initiative, contribute ideas and make a direct impact on the online business.
Key responsibilities:
Manage and optimize LAYERED's day-to-day e-commerce operations, ensuring an engaging and commercially effective shopping experience.
Develop onsite merchandising, product presentation, landing pages and campaign content to improve conversion and sales.
Drive CRM activities, including newsletters, customer segmentation, automated customer journeys and retention initiatives.
Analyze e-commerce performance, customer behaviour and key KPIs to identify opportunities and implement improvements.
Coordinate and execute digital campaigns, product launches and commercial activities in collaboration with the marketing team.
Continuously improve website usability, navigation and the overall customer journey, with a focus on conversion rate optimization (CRO).
Contribute to SEO improvements and explore opportunities to optimize digital content and processes through new technologies and AI.
Collaborate with internal stakeholders to support the ongoing development of the e-commerce business, including operational activities related to the B2B portal.

Your background
We are looking for an experienced, hands-on E-commerce Specialist who can quickly step into the role and take ownership of the daily e-commerce operations. You have a solid background in operational e-commerce and are confident working independently across website optimization, merchandising and CRM. You understand how website performance, customer behaviour and commercial activities contribute to online sales, and you know how to turn insights into practical improvements.
You are comfortable working independently, taking ownership of your responsibilities and managing multiple activities simultaneously. You have a structured and analytical approach, but you are equally comfortable rolling up your sleeves and getting things done.
To succeed at LAYERED, you enjoy working in a smaller, entrepreneurial organisation where collaboration, flexibility and initiative are part of everyday work. You are solution-oriented, proactive and confident in identifying opportunities and driving improvements without extensive guidance.
We would like you to have:
Solid experience in an operational e-commerce role, with the ability to take ownership and deliver results from the start.
Hands-on experience managing and optimizing an online store, including product presentation, onsite merchandising and website content.
Practical experience in CRM and email marketing, including newsletters, customer segmentation, automated flows and performance optimization.
A strong commercial understanding of e-commerce KPIs, conversion, customer behaviour and online sales.
Experience using analytics and performance data to identify opportunities and implement improvements.
The ability to independently plan, prioritise and execute e-commerce activities.
Experience working with content and campaigns in collaboration with marketing teams.
Fluency in both Swedish and English, written and spoken.

Experience with Shopify or similar e-commerce platforms, an understanding of B2B e-commerce, and an interest in GEO/SEO, AI and emerging digital technologies are considered advantages.
What LAYERED Offers
LAYERED offers an opportunity to take a central commercial leadership role within a Swedish design brand with an established international presence and clear ambitions for continued growth.
You will have significant influence over the company’s commercial direction, working closely with the CEO to shape the next phase of development. With e-commerce as a key growth driver and further potential within international markets and B2B, you will have the opportunity to develop new business opportunities and strengthen the company’s commercial foundation.
You will join an entrepreneurial organisation with short decision-making processes, close collaboration and the opportunity to make a tangible impact on the business.
Location & Start
The position is based in central Stockholm, with a start date in March 2027.
Contact & Application
In this recruitment, LAYERED is partnering with E-commerce Recruit. If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact the responsible recruiter, Julia Salming, at at julia@ecommercerecruit.se.
Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible. We look forward to receiving your application!

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.
This position reports to: Head of Strategy & M&A.
Position overview:
You will be a member of the Division's strategy team and report directly to the Division Head of Strategy. Together, the team provides the Division President and the Business Line leaders with the facts and analysis behind their strategic decisions.
In a typical month you will research a market or a competitor, build the numbers behind a business case, profile a company proposed as an acquisition or partner, and prepare the material for the monthly follow-up of strategic initiatives. You will help shape strategic questions, conduct valuable research, get to validated numbers, collaborate across business lines and functions, and produce high-quality first drafts.
We believe in combining careful thinking with modern tools. You should be comfortable using and building AI-enabled workflows and agents to accelerate analysis and execution, while maintaining responsibility for data security, accuracy, and ownership on the conclusions you draw.
You are expected to form your own view, think critically constructively and professionally lead defined workstreams from question to decision-ready output.
Key responsibilities
Analysis and drafting:
Researches markets, customers and competitors and analyzes internal business data to develop and evaluate growth opportunities.
Builds financial models (market size, growth, cost, profitability) and business plans, with sources and assumptions documented.
Produces high-quality first drafts of briefs, reports and presentations for Division, Business Area and corporate reviews.
Follows competitor, market and technology developments, keeps the Division's market data current and prepares regular updates for leadership.

Planning and follow-up:
Supports the annual strategic planning cycle and the monthly follow-up of strategic initiatives: collects and checks input from the Business Lines, updates trackers and dashboards, and prepares the review material.

Acquisitions and partnerships:
Screens and profiles companies and technologies as acquisition or partnership candidates, including inbound proposals, and keeps the pipeline records up to date.
Supports strategy projects and the Division's part in acquisition and partnership projects run with the Business Area Automation M&A team, including analysis, coordination of Business Line input and follow-up of assigned tasks.

The strategy function:
Owns defined analytical workstreams supporting strategy workshops and leadership-team reviews, from preparation through follow-up.
Helps continuously improve the team's analytical tools, templates and AI-enabled ways of working.
Maintains the function's planning calendar, files and information base and responds to recurring information requests.

Key requirements
Relevant professional experience: 5+ years of experience in management consulting, transaction advisory, corporate strategy, business development, business controlling, or a comparable analytical role in an industrial environment.
Academic background: University degree in business, economics, engineering, the natural sciences or a related discipline.
Financial and analytical capabilities: Solid financial-modelling skills and sound understanding of P&L, cash flow, business cases, valuation fundamentals and scenario analysis. Models should be transparent, decision-oriented and structured so that assumptions and sensitivities can be readily reviewed.
Structured problem-solving: Ability to translate ambiguous business questions into clear hypotheses, analytical workplans and practical recommendations.
Executive communication and synthesis: Ability to translate complex analyses and incomplete information into clear, compelling, and decision-ready presentations with a well-structured narrative, tailored to different audiences from senior executives to business and product management.
AI fluency and applied experience: Broad practical fluency with generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, and related productivity tools. Demonstrated ability to build and leverage AI-enabled workflows to improve research, analysis, financial modeling, and communication while maintaining rigorous standards for validation, confidentiality, intellectual property protection, and data security.
Rigor and commercial judgment: High standards for data accuracy, source transparency, and validation combined with the ability to connect analytical findings to strategic and financial implications, identify the assumptions that matter, and distinguish between an interesting observation and a decision-relevant insight.
Independent workstream ownership: Ability to structure and deliver complex analytical workstreams with limited supervision, including defining the approach, identifying required inputs, resolving gaps, forming a point of view and producing decision-ready outputs.
Project coordination: Ability to structure and coordinate work involving multiple contributors, including timelines, required inputs, open topics, dependencies, and follow-up actions.
Cross-functional collaboration: Ability in engaging stakeholders across Finance, Sales, Business Lines, and other functions, including senior stakeholders, to obtain input and keep work on track
Curiosity paired with the ability to gain effectiveness quickly in unfamiliar industrial markets, technologies, and business models
Confidentiality and integrity: Professional and discreet handling of confidential and business-sensitive information.
Language: Full professional proficiency in written and spoken English.
Experience from ABB or from another industrial technology company.

What the role offers:
You will work close to Division and Business Line leadership and see how strategic decisions in a global industrial business are prepared and made. The role is a solid base for a later move into a business role in the Division or the wider ABB group.
Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.
Ready to make an impact?
Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

We are seeking a skilled and experienced Software Engineer with expertise in React, Typescript, and Next.JS to join our dynamic development team. Strong working experience in Next.js, React, Typescript, Tailwind CSS, Github actions

 AI First development mindset

Qualifications
WHO YOU ARE
We are looking for people with…
Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience), and 6+ years of experience as a Software Engineer.
Proven work experience as a Frontend Engineer, preferably with a focus on Next.JS 
Strong proficiency in JavaScript, Typescript, HTML, and CSS.
Experience in system design, headless CMS, component-driven architectures, e-commerce, SaaS, or large-scale enterprise applications
Experience with React.js and its core principles. 
Experience with Node.js is preferable.
Strong communication skills to collaborate with our clients and gather requirements. 
Familiarity with popular React libraries and frameworks such as Redux, React Router, or Next.js. 
Understanding of responsive design principles and mobile-first development. 
Knowledge of frontend build tools and module bundlers such as Webpack or Babel. 
Experience with version control systems, preferably Git. 
Ability to collaborate effectively in a team environment and communicate technical concepts. 
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. 
Ability to quickly learn and adapt to new technologies and frameworks. 
Experience with backend technologies and RESTful APIs. 
Familiarity with testing frameworks such as Jest or React Testing Library. 
Knowledge of UI/UX design principles and ability to work closely with designers. 
Familiarity with Agile/Scrum development methodologies

Additional Information
WHO WE ARE 
H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make. 
We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. 

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE 
At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. 
Staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. 
Included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here. 
Collective Agreement and ITP pensions competitive to Swedish market. 
30 days vacation, health care allowance and good work-life balance. 
Additional perks and discounts from Benify. 

JOIN US 
Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are. 
This is a fulltime permanent position, starting as soon as possible according to agreement. The role is a hybrid position, based in our office in Stockholm, Sweden. 
Apply as soon as possible by sending in your CV in English. Due to data policies, we only accept applications through career page. 
Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here. We are eager to meet you!

Shaping tomorrow's technology
At Function & Software Defined Vehicles (FSDV), we shape tomorrow’s technology by delivering sustainable,innovative, and data‑driven solutions that improve safety, efficiency, and performance throughout the vehicle lifecycle. We align our electrical and software architecture with business and operational models to fully leverage the potential of Software Defined Vehicles.

In this position, you will combine your deep technical expertise with strong leadership and project coordination skills, working closely with Tier 1 suppliers, and cross-functional engineering teams. Extensive experience in automotive electronics development.
Proven experience developing ECUs and exposure to High-Performance Computing (HPC) platforms.

Experience in automotive validation and verification activities.
Experience in project management or technical coordination within automotive development programs.
Hands-on experience with:
Action plan management
Failure analysis and root cause investigations
8D problem-solving methodology
Progress tracking and project follow-up
Experience working in cross-functional environments involving hardware, software, and verification teams.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
Professional proficiency in English.

Experience managing complex automotive programs involving multiple stakeholders and supplier networks.
Knowledge of automotive development processes and product lifecycle management.
Experience with system integration and issue resolution in multidisciplinary environments.
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, international engineering organization.

 
Key Competencies
Automotive electronics expertise
Technical leadership
Structured and analytical problem-solving
Cross-functional collaboration
Project planning and execution
Effective communication and stakeholder management
Supplier and customer interface management
Results-driven mindset

 
Why Join Us?
This is an opportunity to make a significant impact on cutting-edge automotive technologies and contribute to innovative products that shape the future of mobility. You will work alongside talented engineers in a collaborative, international environment where your expertise, leadership, and ideas will help drive technical excellence and meaningful results.
In this role, you will report to the Head of ECU and HW
Ready to take the next step in your career? We look forward to hearing from you.

We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities.

Bring your curiosity, your expertise, and your collaborative energy, and together, we’ll turn bold ideas into tangible solutions for our customers and contribute to a more sustainable tomorrow.

At Voyado we’re growing internationally, and with growth comes new opportunities, challenges, and decisions to make. That’s where you come in!
We’re looking for an FP&A Lead who combines a sharp analytical mind with a strong commercial mindset. Someone who’s curious about the business behind the numbers, enjoys working with people, and isn’t afraid to challenge assumptions or bring new ideas to the table.
This is a role where you’ll get the best of both worlds: taking the lead in a small team while staying close to the business and getting hands-on with the numbers yourself.
Sound like your kind of challenge? Keep reading!
About the role
As our FP&A Lead, you’ll connect financial performance with what’s happening across the business.
You’ll provide day-to-day leadership for a team of business controllers, setting priorities and supporting their success without formal people-management responsibilities. Working closely with stakeholders across Voyado, you’ll turn financial insights into meaningful conversations that help drive smarter business decisions.
You’ll also help develop our FP&A processes and ways of working as we continue to scale. You’ll report directly to our CFO, Björn Källén.
Some things you'll be up to:
Partner with the business. Work closely with stakeholders, understand their challenges, challenge assumptions, and bring financial and commercial perspectives to the table.
Stay hands-on. Own financial planning, forecasting, performance follow-ups, and analysis for your business areas.
Connect the dots. Analyze SaaS metrics and business performance to identify opportunities, understand what’s driving growth, and support better decisions.
Lead by example. Guide the team’s day-to-day work, support your colleagues, and foster collaboration, ownership, and continuous improvement.
Challenge and improve. Help develop our FP&A processes, reporting, and tools, including exploring how automation and AI can help us work smarter.

Who you are
First things first: we’re not looking for someone who simply loves spreadsheets and financial reporting. We’re looking for someone who loves understanding a business and using numbers to make a difference.
We believe you bring:
Solid experience in FP&A, business controlling, commercial finance, or a similar business-oriented finance role.
Hands-on experience in tech/B2B SaaS, with a strong understanding of recurring revenue models and key metrics such as ARR, churn, retention, and customer economics.
Strong analytical skills and the ability to turn financial data into actionable business insights.
A commercial mindset and experience working closely with stakeholders to influence business decisions.
Experience in financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and performance analysis.
The ability to guide and support others, bring people together, and create structure and momentum in a team.
Professional fluency in English.

Experience leading or coordinating others is a plus, but what matters most is your ability to take initiative, bring people together, and lead by example.
Your background doesn’t have to follow the traditional finance path. What matters is that you understand the commercial side, enjoy working with people, and know how to turn insights into action.
High Impact. Great People. Real Growth.
You’ll join a growing international SaaS company where finance plays an important role in shaping the business.
You’ll have the opportunity to make a real impact. With plenty of room to challenge existing ways of working, bring new ideas, and influence how we grow, this is a role where your contribution will truly matter.
And of course, we want you to enjoy the journey along the way!
Some of our benefits:
30 days of vacation
Wellness allowance
Personal development opportunities
Summits and team activities
Four days from the office and one day from home

About Voyado
Voyado is the agentic OS for retail. AI is only as good as what it knows about the business, so Voyado brings customer, product, order, and behavioral data together in one connected system, creating the context retail runs on. With retail intelligence and agentic reasoning on top, AI agents use that single source of truth to make informed decisions and act across the full customer journey.
By combining customer data with product intelligence, Voyado helps retailers deliver more relevant experiences across every channel — online and in-store. The result is more traffic, higher conversions, stronger customer relationships, and measurable business impact.
We’re growing across Europe and are looking for people who want to help shape the future of retail technology.
Ready to make an impact?
Fantastic! 🎉
Applying is easy — just upload your resume. We’d love to hear what excites you about this role and what challenges you’re eager to take on. Be yourself, and let your passion shine through.
Additional information
As part of our recruitment process, we conduct a background check on the final candidate.
Making it personal with AI
We believe you’ll position yourself best for success in the interview process by being yourself, with support from AI where it makes sense. Later in the process, you may even be expected to use AI. At the end of the day, what matters is meeting you — the person behind the application.
There is no such thing as a perfect candidate; we’re all human, so please bring your authentic self. Don’t let AI over-polish your CV or answers to the point where we can’t hear your real voice, because that’s what we care about most.

Are you looking for your next challenge in Firmware Development?
We are looking for a curious, driven, and engaged Firmware Developer to help shape the future of our connected smart lock solutions. In this role, you will contribute to the design, development, testing, and maintenance of innovative products that deliver secure and seamless access experiences to customers around the world.
Join ASSA ABLOY Opening Solutions in Malmö, Sweden, and become part of a talented team where knowledge transfer, innovation, and engagement are at the heart of everything we do. We offer an environment that empowers you to grow professionally, take ownership of your work, and build a career you can be proud of.
At ASSA ABLOY, our success is built on the values of Empowerment, Innovation, and Integrity. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and forward-thinking culture where new ideas are encouraged, people are inspired to make an impact, and collectively develop market-leading solutions that help our customers live, work, and move through the world more safely and conveniently.
What you would do as our Firmware Developer
You will join a small team of experts and play a key role in developing innovative connected products from concept to market. Working in a team-oriented, cross-functional environment, you will help create secure, dependable, and high-performing embedded solutions that deliver exceptional user experiences.
You would also:
Analyse product and system requirements and translate them into effective firmware architectures and technical solutions.
Design, develop, test, and maintain embedded firmware for both new product development and existing product enhancements.
Collaborate closely with hardware, cloud, mobile, and product teams to ensure seamless integration and successful product delivery.
Contribute to the development of secure, reliable, and scalable technologies for the next generation of connected access solutions.
Participate in technical reviews, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement activities to strengthen product quality, performance, and engineering practices.

The skills and experience you need 
We are looking for someone who:
Holds a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems, or a related field, combined with 3-7 years of professional experience in embedded real-time software development.
Demonstrates strong programming skills in C and a solid comprehension of RTOS concepts, including threading, synchronization, memory management, and interrupt handling, along with hands-on experience in embedded software development, debugging, and modern development practices using tools such as J-Link, GDB, Git, or similar.
Possesses strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to engage effectively in cross-functional teams and contribute to the successful delivery of complex embedded software solutions.
Is fluent in English, both written and spoken. Proficiency in Swedish is considered an advantage.
Is passionate about developing high-quality embedded systems and has a proactive mindset toward learning new technologies, improving software quality, driving innovation, and taking ownership of their work.

Ideally, you would also have experience with Zephyr RTOS; microcontroller platforms from vendors such as Nordic, STMicroelectronics, or NXP; secure firmware development including secure boot, cryptography, key management, and certificate handling; IoT protocols and connectivity technologies such as MQTT, Matter, Bluetooth® Low Energy (BLE), Wi-Fi, and Thread; low-power battery-operated IoT devices; peripheral driver development for interfaces such as SPI, I2C, and UART; as well as Python programming and test automation.
What we offer
We’re passionate about providing amazing opportunities and benefits, so you can continue and progress a lifelong career with us – here’s what we have to offer:
Learning and career development opportunities, whether it’s online learning, management training or enhancing your skills. 
A competitive salary and benefits package.
A dynamic and inclusive work environment.
The chance to make a meaningful impact in attracting and retaining top talent.

We review applications regularly, so don’t wait
We are building diverse, inclusive teams, and encourage applications from everyone who can see themselves working with us. Just set up your profile and apply here.
To make sure your personal data is safe, we don’t look at any applications sent by email or post.
If you have any questions about the role or the process, email Alexandra Kymäläinen, Talent Acquisition Business Partner, at alexandra.kymalainen@assaabloy.com

At TRATON Group, we believe that the whole can be greater than the sum of its parts. Together with our brands we can make the future of transportation more sustainable - Let's make a difference together.
 
The TRATON AB office, located in Södertälje, consists of experienced colleagues with various backgrounds and nationalities from all TRATON Group brands. We enjoy solving strategic problems cross functional and cross brand in the TRATON Group. We strive for a climate where opinions and knowledge are openly shared within and between teams and we welcome new ideas in order to create dynamic synergies. 
 
With its brands Scania, MAN, Volkswagen Truck & Bus and International, TRATON Group is one of the world's leading commercial vehicle manufacturers. Its offering comprises light-duty commercial vehicles, trucks, and buses. At TRATON, you are an important part of something bigger. Joining us means gaining access to the ins and outs of the entire transportation industry. As part of a global team of industry experts, you get to think bigger, experience more, and reach further. Being bigger also means being stronger. Together with our brands, we have the collective power to transform transportation. Find out more: www.traton.com
Role Summary
As a Product Cost Controller, you will drive product cost planning, analysis, and optimization to support the profitability of TRATON's products. Working closely with R&D, Controlling, and brand teams across the Group, you will set cost targets, evaluate cost performance, and identify improvement opportunities. The role combines financial analysis, technical understanding, and cross-functional collaboration in an international environment.
Job Responsibilities
 
As part of the Group Product Cost Controlling team, you will work cross-functionally with TRATON AB, local R&D entities, and brand Controlling teams. Together, you are responsible for calculating, challenging, and tracking product costs for current and future products.
 
Your responsibilities include:
 
Deriving top-down product cost targets from a market perspective in early product development phases
Setting clear cost ambitions to secure long-term profitability
Driving and facilitating cross-functional discussions, workshops, and benchmark activities to identify and implement cost-optimizing measures
Performing product cost calculations throughout the entire product lifecycle
Consolidating cost data into comprehensive product cost views across all brands
Presenting analyses and results in cross-functional committees and to senior stakeholders
Tracking and monitoring product cost development over time
Conducting deviation analysis and supporting change management activities

 
As this is a Group function, you will maintain a holistic TRATON perspective and collaborate frequently with all brands within the Group.
Who You Are
You combine analytical strength with technical curiosity and a strong business mindset. You are comfortable working close to product development and thrive in environments where finance meets engineering.
 
We believe you bring:
 
A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field, with a strong interest in technical matters
5-10 years of experience within product cost controlling of hardware products, or related areas such as Purchasing, R&D, Project Management, or Strategy
Strong analytical capability and a high level of quality awareness and accountability
A structured, communicative, and collaborative working style
The ability to present complex data in a clear and compelling way
A genuine interest in working in a diverse, international environment with stakeholders across the globe
Fluency in English (written and verbal). Swedish or German is considered a strong advantage

 
You are a team player who challenges constructively, drives progress, and contributes to securing long-term profitability through structured cost governance.
